sum: 3 E Network Technology Group Limited, through its subsidiaries, engages in the provision of business-to-business information technology (IT) solutions for companies in Hong Kong. The company offers smart property management systems, a smart property management system for property management companies; and restaurant management software system. It also sells hardware products, including enterprise-grade memory products, storage modules, solid-state drives, and other storage components for artificial intelligence technology companies, data center operators, and cloud computing service providers. In addition, the company is involved in sales and marketing activities; data center construction; and provision of IT consulting and solutions. It serves various industries and sectors, such as food establishments, real estate, exhibition and conferencing, and clean energy utilities. 3 E Network Technology Group Limited was incorporated in 2021 and is based in Hong Kong.
ceo: Dr. Tingjun  Yang (CEO, IT Security Officer & Director)
